subject: Portal enrollment — manifest & PO routing (next steps)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@procureco.com>, procureco-ops@procureco.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portal enrollment — manifest & PO routing (next steps)

Hi Hannah / ProcureCo team,

Thanks for taking the time on Friday — this thread will capture the minimal manifest and routing items we need to get BlueBridge activated in your portal and ensure POs can be ingested without delays. High level deliverables we need from ProcureCo: 

1) Vendor evidence bundle (W-9, insurance cert, proof of address, contact list) — please upload to the secure upload link below or attach.
2) Confirm preferred PO routing: Ariba punchout vs. SFTP PO drops. We need the endpoint + sample PO XML (if EDI) or SFTP credentials.
3) Order Form signature: we will route a single order form (OrderForm v1) for signature; ProcureCo legal has asked for a billing contact to be present on the document.
4) Ack SLA: confirm PO acknowledgement window (we request 24–48 hours for acceptance/ack).

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_manifest.xlsx — includes required fields mapping to the BlueBridge PO schema. 

Upload link for evidence: https://redwood-secure-upload.example.com/portal-onboard/bluebridge (preferred)
HubSpot ticket: BBH-7890 (tracking).

Next steps (proposed):
- Hannah: upload evidence bundle + sample PO by Wed 3/17.
- ProcureCo ops: confirm PO delivery method and provide endpoint by Wed 3/17.
- Redwood legal (Mateo): review any redline requests on the Order Form by end of week.

If any of the internal folks want to split ownership of the upload/PO verification, call it out here. Thanks!

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_manifest.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@procureco.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procureco-ops@procureco.com
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@bluebridgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment — manifest & PO routing (next steps)

Thanks Monica — quick answers below. Sorry for the cliff-notes, ops is looped.

1) Evidence upload: we'll place a zip with W-9, COI, vendor contact csv on the ProcureCo SFTP this afternoon. I’ll paste the path once uploaded.
2) PO routing: BlueBridge elected SFTP PO drops (they do not use punchout). We will provide an SFTP hostname and username for the drop folder; sample PO XML attached.
3) Order Form: legal prefers redline inline in DocuSign before final signature. Can you confirm which fields need to be present so our signatory matrix is correct?
4) Ack SLA: we can support 48-hour ack for new vendors during onboarding.

Attached: sample_po_bluebridge.xml (xml) — small sample of the PO structure. Will send SFTP creds to your ops alias shortly.

On the DocuSign point, Sam (BlueBridge) asked that billing and remit-to fields both be present on the Order Form — they use a separate remit-to address for their finance team.

Hannah
Hannah Lee
ProcureCo Vendor Ops
[Attachment: sample_po_bluebridge.xml (xml)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@procureco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment — manifest & PO routing (next steps)

Hi all,

I reviewed the sample PO and the onboarding manifest. A couple of legal items to flag up front so they can be resolved before signature: 

- Order Form fields: include separate "Billing Contact" and "Remit-To Address" fields as Hannah requested. We need clear mapping in the manifest for the AR contact versus the technical contact.
- PO acceptance clause: recommend adding a short sentence in the Order Form confirming that Redwood's acceptance of a PO is subject to the Master Services Agreement (MSA) terms and any previously agreed exceptions. This avoids any implied new terms arriving via PO.
- Insurance evidence: COI must name Redwood Inference as certificate holder with policy limits listed in Exhibit A (we'll attach Exhibit A template).

I will prepare a single-page redline of the Order Form (tracked changes) and post it to the DocuSign packet so ProcureCo can route it to their legal team. If ProcureCo wants to push a counter-redline, please provide it as a Word doc rather than inline comments — that helps our redline tool.

Action items: 
- Mateo: upload OrderForm_redline_v1.docx by EOD Tue 3/16.
- ProcureCo: confirm SFTP endpoint & upload evidence.
- Monica / Ops: confirm we have the correct PO XML element mapping for remit-to vs bill-to (see manifest col H/I).

--
Mateo Alvarez
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: Exhibit_A_insurance_template.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@procureco.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal enrollment — manifest & PO routing (next steps)

Monica — ops note.

We support both SFTP drops and Ariba if a partner enables it, but since ProcureCo confirmed SFTP, please get the following from them:
- SFTP hostname, username, and the exact drop folder path (not just root).
- Preferred filename pattern for incoming POs (e.g., PO_{{PO_NUMBER}}.xml).
- Any sample failing POs and how they want NACKs handled (email vs file).

I reviewed the manifest and mapped remit-to -> PO/Invoice/RemitTo node and billing_contact -> PO/BillTo/Contact. Marissa will validate that mapping and return a quick schema compatibility note.

Also please attach the signed_orderform_v1.pdf to the HubSpot ticket once executed. If ProcureCo wants DocuSign routing, we can pre-fill HMAC metadata so we can match the executed PDF to the HubSpot record automatically.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: orderform_stub_for_signing.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks everyone — short recap and owners so nothing falls through the cracks: 

1) ProcureCo (Hannah / ops): SFTP upload of evidence to be completed today. Please email the SFTP path and creds (or SFTP key) to procureco-ops@redwood.com and include the sample PO filename convention.
2) Mateo: will upload OrderForm_redline_v1.docx to the DocuSign packet by EOD today. Mateo, please cc monica.patel and laura.bennett so we can see the redline in-line.
3) Marissa: validate remit-to/billing mappings against the manifest and respond with any required field name changes by EOD Wed 3/17.
4) Laura / Ops: once SFTP creds received, run a test ingest of the sample_po_bluebridge.xml and share any parsing errors (aim: one test pass this week).
5) Sam (BlueBridge): confirm the remit-to address that should appear on the signed Order Form.

I’ve attached the manifest we discussed and the orderform stub. I’ll push the HubSpot ticket BBH-7890 an update when we have the executed PDF.

If there are blockers on the DocuSign redline approach, call it out now; otherwise we’ll proceed with a single DocuSign packet and staged signature order (ProcureCo ops -> BlueBridge -> Redwood signatory).

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
